errors.unauthorized: Credential invalid or expired — open Repair to enter a new API key or access token.
errors.missing_scope: The stored credential is missing the controls:write scope, so this action is disabled. Ask for a key with pools:read and controls:write.
errors.missing_read_scope: The stored credential has no read scope at all (pools:read, controls:read or history:read) — open Repair to enter a new API key or access token.
errors.control_not_allowed: Cover control is turned off for this device. Enable "Allow cover control" in the device settings first — the cover can trap someone in the water, so this is off by default.
